messages.content: I’m at the Hotel Folly checkout page. It shows the Two Queen Studio for July 12-18, two adults and one 14-year-old, and a total of $1,977.36. The payment box says $659.12 now and $1,318.24 at the property, but I don’t see parking included.

The room occupancy and six-night room total are consistent with the quote. Since parking is $30 per night for six nights, add $180 separately. That makes the mandatory hotel cost $2,157.36, even though the checkout payment box only divides the $1,977.36 room-and-tax amount.
So what exactly will be charged today, and what should I expect when we arrive?

The card will be charged a $659.12 two-night deposit today. At the property, the remaining room balance is $1,318.24, plus $180 for parking, for a total of $1,498.24 payable there. Together those amounts equal $2,157.36 in mandatory hotel charges.
The cancellation language says 6:00 p.m. local hotel time on July 7. Translate that clearly for me before I submit it.

Hotel Folly is in South Carolina, so the cutoff is July 7 at 6:00 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time. Cancel by then for the deposit to remain refundable; after that cutoff, the $659.12 deposit becomes nonrefundable under the displayed terms.
And the balcony and all three guests are actually listed, correct?
Yes. The checkout details show one Two Queen Studio with an ocean-facing private balcony, occupied by two adults and one child age 14. No extra-person charge appears in the itemization.
Good. Complete the reservation with the authorized card and record the full trip estimate, including the breakfast and Charleston travel amounts we already set.
